div.div:
LENDING RELATIONSHIP PRINCIPLE
SikaCredit owns the loan and repayment objects.
The customer participates in the lending relationship as borrower.
Loan and repayment remain SikaCredit-domain objects.
Their financial consequences may affect other institutional positions
without transferring institutional ownership.
